meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会给 HyperFrames 的画面动效（如推拉、缩放/重构图、Ken Burns）写关键帧，并按规则用 hyperframes 命令检查是否通过。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推拉、缩放/重构图或 Ken Burns 等画面动效，或需要用 GSAP 等写关键帧、做诊断时触发；宏观场景策略、品牌设计、找素材等不归它管。

say.text: 给这个 HyperFrames 合成加一段先推近再拉远的镜头动画。
say.note: Claude 会写缩放/位移关键帧并自动校验。

say.text: 让画面主体从左侧平滑移到右侧，并在末尾停住。
say.note: 会生成一条平移关键帧并校验。

say.text: 让标题文字逐字上移入场，行距和字距保持不变。
say.note: 会按字符级文字关键帧处理并保持可读。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude writes keyframes for HyperFrames visual motion (e.g., punch-in/out, zoom/reframe, Ken Burns) and checks the result with hyperframes CLI commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in/out, zoom/reframe, etc., or keyframes/diagnostics via tools like GSAP. Not for scene strategy, brand, or media sourcing.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in then punch-out camera move to this HyperFrames composition.
say_en.note: Claude writes scale/translate keyframes and validates them.

say_en.text: Move the subject smoothly from the left to the right and stop at the end.
say_en.note: It creates a translation keyframe and validates it.

say_en.text: Make the title text rise character by character without changing the layout.
say_en.note: It handles the text as keyframes and keeps it readable.
